app_snapshots_installs_range_chk.name: app_snapshots_installs_range_chk
app_snapshots_installs_range_chk.value: coalesce("app_snapshots"."min_installs", 0) >= 0 and ("app_snapshots"."max_installs" is null or "app_snapshots"."max_installs" >= coalesce("app_snapshots"."min_installs", 0))

steam_chart_entries_rank_chk.name: steam_chart_entries_rank_chk
steam_chart_entries_rank_chk.value: "steam_chart_entries"."rank" between 1 and 100 and ("steam_chart_entries"."last_week_rank" is null or "steam_chart_entries"."last_week_rank" >= 1)

steam_snapshots_reviews_group_chk.name: steam_snapshots_reviews_group_chk
steam_snapshots_reviews_group_chk.value:
("steam_snapshots"."review_total" is null and "steam_snapshots"."review_positive" is null and "steam_snapshots"."review_negative" is null and "steam_snapshots"."reviews_captured_at" is null)
        or ("steam_snapshots"."review_positive" >= 0 and "steam_snapshots"."review_negative" >= 0
            and "steam_snapshots"."review_total" = "steam_snapshots"."review_positive" + "steam_snapshots"."review_negative"
            and "steam_snapshots"."reviews_captured_at" is not null and "steam_snapshots"."review_purchase_scope" is not null)

steam_snapshots_players_group_chk.name: steam_snapshots_players_group_chk
steam_snapshots_players_group_chk.value:
("steam_snapshots"."current_players" is null and "steam_snapshots"."players_captured_at" is null)
        or ("steam_snapshots"."current_players" >= 0 and "steam_snapshots"."players_captured_at" is not null)

steam_snapshots_has_signal_chk.name: steam_snapshots_has_signal_chk
steam_snapshots_has_signal_chk.value: "steam_snapshots"."review_total" is not null or "steam_snapshots"."current_players" is not null

studio_profiles_capability_levels_chk.name: studio_profiles_capability_levels_chk
studio_profiles_capability_levels_chk.value: "studio_profiles"."capability_2d" in ('none', 'basic', 'strong') and "studio_profiles"."capability_3d" in ('none', 'basic', 'strong') and "studio_profiles"."online_backend_capability" in ('none', 'basic', 'strong') and "studio_profiles"."content_production_capability" in ('none', 'basic', 'strong') and "studio_profiles"."live_ops_capability" in ('none', 'basic', 'strong')
